retained_failures: The first release-audit evaluation used three descriptive but unsupported risk-class labels and failed schema validation before publication. Replacing only those labels with the evaluator's data, public, and external vocabulary produced the corrected result.
Standalone verifier invocations that omitted PYTHONPATH, the first one-second full-unit shell timeout, and the initially incomplete exact-outcome fixture remain recorded with their corrected results.
The clean clone's nonexistent verifier name and definition-only secret match remain recorded beside corrected passing checks.
The first combined post-clone wrapper reached its 124-second ceiling before a complete result; the unchanged-tree seven-minute-bound rerun passed.

The original-detail image viewer repeatedly framed only the incident-table strip even though normalized high detail and pixel comparison proved the PNG bytes complete; the viewer artifact remains retained.
limitations: GitHub has no configured checks for PR #17, so repository, clean-clone, and direct public-state gates are the authoritative validation.
Thirty scenarios close the measured split-topology gap but do not satisfy the separate at-least-48-case v0.1.0 target.
The unkeyed chain and endpoint do not authenticate their writer or resist complete chain-and-anchor recomputation.
Real operational infrastructure, production identity, immutable storage, external collectors, signing, paid services, and container packaging remain out of scope.

decision.rationale: Every risk-matched contract, evaluation, runtime, package, real-surface, clean-clone, rendering, rights, evidence-retention, security, and current remote-state check passes with no unresolved discrepancy and unchanged authority boundaries.
